observations: Road bicycle with drop handlebars and red grip tape.
Black frame with red branding/accents on the down tube and top tube.
External derailleur drivetrain with multiple gears.
Kickstand installed near the rear axle.
The frame tubes appear thick, characteristic of aluminum construction.
A 'JIJI.NG' watermark is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The photo shows a multi-speed drivetrain, but the number of gears on the cassette and chainrings cannot be counted.
The tube thickness suggests aluminum, but material cannot be confirmed without a close-up of welds or a magnet test.
The photo resolution is too low to inspect for surface rust on the chain, bolts, or cables.

risks.proof: Close-up photos of the frame welds (head tube, bottom bracket, and seat tube junctions).

risks.risk: Worn drivetrain (stretched chain or shark-finned teeth)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rear cassette and front chainrings.
risks.if_unproven: priced as requiring a full drivetrain replacement

risks.proof: Video showing the seatpost being adjusted/moved.

proof_requests: Clear, high-resolution photo of the brand and model name on the frame.
Close-up photo of the gear shifters and derailleurs to identify the component group (e.g., Shimano).
Video of the bicycle being ridden or the gears being shifted through the full range.
Close-up photo of the tires to check for dry rot or tread wear.
response.reason: The brand and model name on the frame are illegible. Because bicycle value is highly dependent on the manufacturer and the quality of the component groupset, these must be identified before a price can be determined.
